title: Jean K NDE 3063
content: I was at a local state park lake with Douglas, my four year old son and a girl friend of mine. I was walking back to our blanket and felt like I was gliding down to it - maybe passing out. Then my mind was blank. Then I remembered a man carrying me up to the medical building, then going blank again. I felt being laid down on a hard bed and someone's voice asking if I was with anyone. I guess my son had followed me and told them my friend was with me. Then I went blank again but I heard everyone talking. Mentally I was trying to talk to them to say I was okay but, I couldn't talk there was no voice. I felt as if the air/sky around me was a beautiful, light blue and so very clear, no clouds. I then heard someone say, 'I can't feel her pulse and there is no heartbeat.' And, then I heard a girl's voice say the same thing. During this time, I was trying to tell them that I was really okay but, yet I wasn't in the same level as they were. I felt my body move up to a sitting position and saw a beautiful light or brightness in the sky and I felt so good and safe. Then next thing I remember was being in an ambulance and the medics trying to give me oxygen, then it seemed like a few minutes later I was awake. Years later in life I had taken a course 'Death and Dying' for college, it was taught by Sister M. I told her about my experience and her knowing Elizabeth Kubler Ross had me write down what had happen. Elizabeth confirmed that I had a near death experience.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She described feeling like she was 'gliding' and later 'felt my body move up to a sitting position' while hearing others and trying to communicate without a voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: She perceived 'the air/sky around me was a beautiful, light blue and so very clear, no clouds' and saw 'a beautiful light or brightness in the sky.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: She felt like she was 'gliding' and 'maybe passing out' at a state park lake; later she heard others say there was no pulse and no heartbeat.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated 'blank' periods; auditory awareness of people speaking; inability to speak ('there was no voice'); later awareness in an ambulance receiving oxygen.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Felt faint/blankness, then intermittent awareness of being carried/laid down and hearing staff; perceived clear blue sky and bright light; then later found herself in an ambulance and awoke.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple episodes of going 'blank again' between moments of awareness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Primarily auditory awareness with intermittent blankness; she tried to communicate mentally but had 'no voice.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I can't feel her pulse and there is no heartbeat.” / “the air/sky around me was a beautiful, light blue and so very clear, no clouds.” / “I felt so good and safe.”
